POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
